einzeiler: The rise and fall of Majapahit, medieval Indonesia's greatest thalassocracy.
kurzfassung: This episode explores the rise and fall of the Majapahit Empire, a dominant Hindu-Buddhist thalassocracy centered on the volcanic island of Java. It traces how the empire built a vast maritime network across Southeast Asia, controlled crucial trade routes like the Strait of Malacca, and left behind magnificent monuments. Finally, it examines the internal civil wars, external pressures from Ming China, and the spread of Islam that led to the empire's collapse.
stichpunkte: Thomas Stamford Raffles explored the ruined temples and capitals of Java, uncovering the legacy of the Majapahit Empire.
Java's geography, shaped by the Pacific Ring of Fire and rich volcanic soil, supported high agricultural productivity and dense populations.
Early kingdoms like Mataram constructed monumental architecture, including the massive Buddhist temple Borobudur and the Hindu Prambanan temple.
Javanese sailors developed advanced large-scale vessels (Jongs) and undertook ambitious maritime voyages to Madagascar, East Africa, and potentially Australia.
Following the collapse of Mataram and the rise of Singasari, King Kertanegara expanded Javanese influence and defied the Mongol Empire under Kublai Khan.
Raden Wijaya founded the Majapahit Empire after defeating both the rebel Jayakatwang and retaliating against the invading Mongol forces.
Under Queen Tribhuvanatunggadewi and Prime Minister Gajah Mada, Majapahit expanded into a vast maritime empire controlling the Nusantara archipelago.
The reign of Hayam Wuruk marked the golden age of Majapahit, characterized by flourishing trade in spices and extensive cultural achievements.
The destructive Regreg civil war and the rising maritime power of Ming China and the Sultanate of Demak severely weakened the empire.
Majapahit ultimately fragmented and fell to the Muslim Sultanate of Demak, ending the era of Hindu-Buddhist dominance on Java.
beschreibung:
Beneath the shade of an Indonesian teak forest, a great brick gateway stands in ruins...
In this episode, I want to tell the story of the Majapahit Empire of medieval Indonesia. I want to show how this empire of the islands grew up on the volcanic island of Java, and how it beat the odds to survive in a world of medieval superpowers. I want to show how Majapahit expanded its influence and dominion to other lands, and undertook voyages that have few precedents in history. And I want to show what happened to bring this empire of the islands finally crashing down...
